changelog: Alerts and delivery without nested navigation
Configuration → Alerts now opens the SIP and learned-pattern Detection editor directly; the nested Delivery/Detection/Email tabs are removed.
Settings → Notifications groups webhook, Telegram, incident investigation, digest and outgoing SMTP in one destination.
changelog_es: Alertas y entrega sin navegación duplicada
Configuration → Alerts abre directamente el editor de detección SIP y patrones aprendidos; desaparece su segundo nivel Delivery/Detection/Email.
Settings → Notifications agrupa en una sola pantalla webhook, Telegram, investigación de incidentes, digest y correo SMTP.
